references.text: Describes how Israel struck down all the men in the cities they conquered, as an example of the implementation of this law
Shows how Israel devoted the cities to destruction and struck down all the men, in accordance with the war law in Deuteronomy 20
Jericho was struck with the sword as a practical application of this war law
The conquest of Ai demonstrates the implementation of this law to strike down all the men with the sword
Joshua struck down the inhabitants with the sword in the Canaanite cities, in accordance with the Lord's command
Hazor and other cities were struck with the sword as fulfillment of this war law
Israel struck down all the men among the Midianites with the sword, as an early example of this practice
Saul was commanded to strike down the Amalekites, as an application of the war law concerning total destruction
